variants.title: 3열 장면형
variants.prompt: Use case: productivity-visual. Create a substantial explanatory illustration for an executive software-architecture presentation about a PC Voice Interaction Agent (VIA). Pure white background, polished technical editorial illustration, clearly drawn desktop computers, actual generic application windows, realistic cursor/selection detail, audio waveform traces, and visual causal connections. Crisp navy contours, pale steel blue surfaces, restrained cyan and sage green emphasis, subtle volume and soft restrained shadows. This is an illustrative product concept, not a screenshot of a real product. No robots, no fantasy AI brains, no neon, no gears as filler, no decorative blob backgrounds. NO text, letters, digits, logos or watermarks anywhere. UI uses neutral lines and empty table cells only. Pictures must explain the mechanics, not just collect disconnected icons. Keep enough negative space for separate native PowerPoint headings and short captions. Do not draw any text boxes, titles, card-grid UI, labels or empty caption boxes. Show no claimed numeric improvements, no before/after performance statistics, no report or email scenario, no real business data. Three needs to convey: (1) a user can keep speaking and correct input even while a work Agent returns a question or result, with the conversation and work staying linked; (2) spoken reference, the cursor/selection on the screen at that moment, and relevant past dialogue/work records must connect to understand the current request; (3) sustained dialogue and screen/state retention consume model-call and RAM resources, while changing models and external Agents creates integration changes. VIA is the user interaction interface, and external Agents execute work. Composition: exactly a 3:1 panoramic canvas, ideally 2400 by 800 pixels. THREE equally wide illustrated mini-scenes side by side, white space between, no frames. Each scene should have rich concrete visual evidence and fill its own square area, keeping equal optical size. LEFT scene: a human user in side profile speaking at a large desktop monitor, a continuous cyan input waveform sweeps from their mouth across the bottom, a contrasting sage response waveform and two incoming translucent question/result panels arrive above it from two work windows at the right; the waveforms visibly overlap in time but continue, and a small cursor editing one segment of the upper transcript ribbon changes only that segment. Keep all UI without text. CENTER scene: large monitor showing a generic spreadsheet grid with a clearly selected rectangular range and a prominent mouse cursor touching the range; one spoken waveform points precisely to that same highlighted range, and two faded earlier window snapshots plus a clock-like timeline fold from behind the monitor into the current highlighted region. The visible relationship must explain voice + current pointing + past context. RIGHT scene: desktop computer cutaway, a small RAM circuitboard with several buffered screen thumbnails visibly stored along it, a cloud processor receiving repeated looped speech signals beside a short stack of token-like discs, and two removable external-agent connectors attached at the edge. Show bounded storage and replaceable connectors concretely, with enough large recognizable detail to read on a projected slide. No abstract stand-alone icon badge composition.
